# Milestone brief — source-truth-m1

**Title:** Revision registry live with license provenance (advisory)
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** source-truth (plans/source-truth/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** 2026-07-13 -> 2026-07-29

## Parent epic

- source-truth-e1 — Revision registry and license provenance
  Per-revision documents registry — work identity, arXiv version, raw-tarball and parse-artifact sha256, parser/chunker version stamps, active/withdrawn/superseded status — with license URIs hydrated via the existing tools/_arxiv_api.py Atom client and a per-revision license decision function running advisory until the e4 cutover. Extends the paper-metadata per-notebook SQLite store pattern (server/paper_metadata_store.py); observable as both live notebooks fully registered plus a per-license coverage report.

## Summary

Per-revision documents registry — work identity, arXiv version, raw-source and parse-artifact sha256, parser/chunker version stamps, active/withdrawn/superseded status — extending the paper-metadata per-notebook SQLite store pattern, with license URIs hydrated via tools/_arxiv_api.py and a per-revision license decision function running advisory-only until the e4 cutover. Observable as both live notebooks registered end-to-end plus a per-license coverage report.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given both live notebooks, when the registry backfill completes, then every ingested revision has a documents row carrying work identity, arXiv version, raw-source sha256, parse-artifact checksum, parser/chunker versions, fetch timestamp, license URI, and active/withdrawn/superseded status
2. Given a revision whose license URI is missing or unrecognized, when the per-revision decision function evaluates it, then it returns license_status=unknown mapping to truncate, logged advisory-only with serving behavior unchanged
3. Given the hydrated registry, when the coverage report runs, then per-license counts for both notebooks are emitted, and a >20% unknown rate on bridgeland-stability surfaces to the owner before any serving cutover

## Depends on

- source-truth-spike-1 — License-URI coverage on a mixed 30-paper sample [status: planned]
